name: board
description: Two users of one backend: what alice posts, bob sees, and the other way round (docs/scenes.md).

steps.name: alice posts
alice: until 10000 posted: hello from alice (1 on the board)

steps.name: bob sees it
steps.bob: until 10000 board: alice: hello from alice

steps.name: alice sees both
alice: until 10000 board: alice: hello from alice | bob: ping 1

steps.name: bob tells alice how many he counted
bob: capture count posted: ping 1 \((\d+) on the board\)

steps.name: everyone sees the last word
steps.all: until 10000 bob: ping 1 | alice: bob counted 2
